functions.name: GetChargeState
functions.description: Returns the current battery and charger state as a table with power, voltage, percentage, and charger status fields.

returns.description: Table fields: plugged_in (boolean), battery_voltage_mv (int32), charger_state (string: off|precharge|normal_charge|finishing_charge), battery_percent (int32), charger_main_fsm (string), charger_main_fsm_raw (int32), charger_jeita_region (string), charger_die_temp_limit_exceeded (boolean), charger_ok_irq_status (int32), charger_nok_irq_status (int32)

functions.example:
local state = Battery.GetChargeState()
print(string.format('%d%% %dmV', state.battery_percent, state.battery_voltage_mv))
if state.charger_state ~= 'off' then
  print('charger: ' .. state.charger_state)
end

categories.name: Pico8
categories.description: Pico-8 API compatibility layer - enables pico-8 style Lua game development

functions.name: pset
functions.description: Set pixel color at (x, y) to c

functions.name: btn
functions.description: Is button i held this frame? Omit i to get a bitfield of all buttons. Buttons: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down, 4 O, 5 X. Only player 0 is wired to a device.

functions.name: btnp
functions.description: Was button i pressed this frame? Omit i to get a bitfield of all buttons. Buttons: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down, 4 O, 5 X. Only player 0 is wired to a device.

functions.name: pico_mode
functions.description: Set Pico framebuffer presentation scale (0 or omitted = full canvas, >0 = fixed scale centered)

functions.name: sspr
functions.description: Draw a stretched rectangle of the sprite sheet

functions.name: mget
functions.description: Get the sprite index stored in a map cell

functions.name: mset
functions.description: Set the sprite index stored in a map cell

functions.name: sget
functions.description: Read a pixel from the sprite sheet

functions.name: sset
functions.description: Write a pixel to the sprite sheet

functions.name: fget
functions.description: Read sprite flags. fget(n) returns the whole byte, fget(n, f) returns flag f as a boolean
functions.example: if fget(tile, 0) then solid = true end

functions.name: fset
functions.description: Write sprite flags. fset(n, v) sets the whole byte, fset(n, f, v) sets flag f

functions.name: pico_flags
functions.description: Install the cart's __gff__ sprite flags from a hex string, or read them back. Emitted by the PICO-8 importer; carts do not normally call this

functions.name: cartdata
functions.description: Claim a 64-number persistent save area. Returns false if saved data already existed

functions.name: dget
functions.description: Read a value from persistent cart data (index 0-63)

functions.name: dset
functions.description: Write a value to persistent cart data (index 0-63)

functions.name: menuitem
functions.description: Add or remove a pause-menu entry (index 1-5). Omit the label to remove the entry

functions.name: peek
functions.description: Read one or more bytes of memory

functions.name: poke
functions.description: Write one or more bytes of memory

functions.name: memcpy
functions.description: Copy a block of memory (overlapping ranges are safe)

functions.name: memset
functions.description: Fill a block of memory with a byte value

functions.name: reload
functions.description: Restore a block of memory from cart ROM. With no arguments, restores the whole cart

functions.name: flip
functions.description: Present the current framebuffer. Unlike PICO-8 this does not wait for the next display frame

functions.name: cocreate
functions.description: Create a coroutine from a function

functions.name: coresume
functions.description: Resume a coroutine, returning success plus any yielded values

functions.name: costatus
functions.description: Return a coroutine's status: running, suspended or dead
functions.example: if costatus(co) == "dead" then co = nil end

functions.name: cowrap
functions.description: Create a coroutine wrapped as a callable function

functions.name: yield
functions.description: Suspend the running coroutine, returning any values passed to the next resume

functions.name: chr
functions.description: Build a string from one or more character ordinals

functions.name: ord
functions.description: Read character ordinals out of a string. The third argument is a count, not an end index

functions.name: del
functions.description: Delete first matching value from table

functions.name: all
functions.example: for v in all(items) do print(v) end

functions.name: foreach
functions.description: Apply callback function to each table element

functions.name: print
functions.description: Draw text with the built-in font. With no x/y it prints at the cursor and drops a line, scrolling the screen at the bottom. Returns the x position after the last character.

returns.description: X position after the last character

functions.name: cursor
functions.description: Set the text cursor used by print() when no coordinates are given, and optionally the pen colour. Returns the previous cursor position.

functions.name: time
functions.description: Seconds the cart has been running, counted in frames
